You didn't show us the sample numbers you were using, but if I put in your example, the code works exactly as expected:

function bankersRound(n, d=2) {
    var x = n * Math.pow(10, d);
    var r = Math.round(x);
    var br = Math.abs(x) % 1 === 0.5 ? (r % 2 === 0 ? r : r-1) : r;
    return br / Math.pow(10, d);
}
number = 1.36500000000001;
console.log(bankersRound(number, 2));
number = 1.365;
console.log(bankersRound(number, 2));
